main:effect:1601.name: 警戒
main:effect:1601.text: 可以攻击相邻的敌人，优先攻击身后的敌人。
main:effect:1601.originalText: Can attack adjacent enemies, attacking backwards in preference.

main:effect:1901.name: 治疗1
main:effect:1901.text: 每回合为受伤最严重的友方生物恢复1点生命值。
main:effect:1901.originalText: Restores 1 HP to the most damaged friendly creature each turn.

main:effect:1902.name: 治疗2
main:effect:1902.text: 每回合为受伤最严重的友方生物恢复2点生命值。
main:effect:1902.originalText: Restores 2 HP to the most damaged friendly creature each turn.

main:effect:3903.name: 人类生命光环3
main:effect:3903.text: 所有其他友方人类获得 +3生命值。
main:effect:3903.originalText: All other friendly Humans gain +3 HP.

main:effect:3907.name: 人类生命光环6
main:effect:3907.text: 所有其他友方人类获得 +6生命值。
main:effect:3907.originalText: All other friendly Humans gain +6 HP.

main:effect:1510.name: 冲锋1
main:effect:1510.text: 每移动2格，本单位的下一次攻击获得 +1攻击力。对弓手造成双倍伤害。
main:effect:1510.source: config_row:31da75a73afdcf2be1c1; TypeID=15; existing effects-zh candidate; Sol-reviewed against complete EffectDes
main:effect:1510.originalText: For each 2 squares this creature moves, it gains +1 Attack for its next attack. Deals double damage to Archers.

main:effect:2101.name: 英勇1
main:effect:2101.text: 当本单位造成伤害时，获得 +1攻击力。
main:effect:2101.originalText: When this creature deals damage, it gains +1 Attack.

main:effect:2102.name: 英勇2
main:effect:2102.text: 当本单位造成伤害时，获得 +2攻击力。
main:effect:2102.originalText: When this creature deals damage, it gains +2 Attack.

main:effect:2602.name: 反击
main:effect:2602.text: 当受到射程范围内的生物攻击时，本单位会进行反击。
main:effect:2602.originalText: When this creature is attacked by a creature in range, it will retaliate.

main:effect:5101.name: 破甲
main:effect:5101.text: 造成的伤害无法被减免。

main:effect:1533.name: 重弩
main:effect:1533.text: 射程+2。弓兵。移动后无法攻击。
main:effect:1533.source: config_row:d171eafa8ec8d2518248; TypeID=15 tail index>=800; direct EffectDes translation candidate
main:effect:1533.originalText: +2 Range. Archer. Cannot attack after moving.

main:effect:1534.name: 连弩
main:effect:1534.text: 射程 +2。弓手。条件允许时，每回合攻击两次。
main:effect:1534.source: config_row:4a57a2a5822168bc2ed3; TypeID=15; existing effects-zh candidate; Sol-reviewed against complete EffectDes
main:effect:1534.originalText: +2 Range. Archer. Attacks twice each round if able.

main:effect:12.name: 贯穿
main:effect:12.text: 攻击目标生物，同时攻击其身后的敌方生物或英雄。
main:effect:12.source: config_row:7b46a1ff46ba387dd158; TypeID=15; existing effects-zh candidate; Sol-reviewed against complete EffectDes
main:effect:12.originalText: Attacks target creature, as well as the enemy creature or hero behind.

main:effect:1519.name: 圣光
main:effect:1519.text: 射程+2。造成的伤害无法被减免，且被消灭的生物无法触发还魂、魂缚或骷髅。
main:effect:1519.source: config_row:41916b68379ef6358dc9; TypeID=15; existing effects-zh candidate; Sol-reviewed against complete EffectDes
main:effect:1519.originalText: +2 Range. Damage dealt cannot be reduced, and creatures killed cannot activate ability Reanimate, Soulbound or Skeleton.

main:effect:1535.name: 信仰1
main:effect:1535.text: 此生物治疗生物或英雄时，获得+1生命值和+1攻击力。
main:effect:1535.source: config_row:90be771bb493fba043ec; TypeID=15; existing effects-zh candidate; Sol-reviewed against complete EffectDes
main:effect:1535.originalText: When this creature cures a creature or hero it gains +1 HP, +1 Attack.

main:effect:1903.name: 治疗3
main:effect:1903.text: 每回合为受伤最严重的友方生物恢复3点生命值。
main:effect:1903.originalText: Restores 3 HP to the most damaged friendly creature each turn.

main:effect:1904.name: 治疗4
main:effect:1904.text: 每回合为受伤最严重的友方生物恢复4点生命值。
main:effect:1904.originalText: Restores 4 HP to the most damaged friendly creature each turn.

main:effect:5701.name: 驱散
main:effect:5701.text: 有50%的概率移除一个随机友方生物身上的一个负面效果。
main:effect:5701.originalText: Has a 50% chance to remove a negative effect from a random friendly creature.

main:effect:4403.name: 殉道
main:effect:4403.text: 承受原本将对相邻友方生物或英雄造成的全部伤害。
main:effect:4403.originalText: Takes all damage that would be dealt to adjacent ally creatures or heroes.

main:effect:3601.name: 鼓舞1
main:effect:3601.text: 使召唤者手中准备值最高的一张卡牌的准备值减少1。
main:effect:3601.originalText: Reduces Countdown of a card with the highest Countdown in summoner's hand by 1.

main:effect:7702.name: 圣洁之力
main:effect:7702.text: 造成的伤害无法被减免，被击杀的生物无法触发复活、灵魂绑定或骷髅能力。
main:effect:7702.originalText: Damage dealt cannot be reduced, and creatures killed cannot activate ability Reanimate, Soulbound or Skeleton.

main:effect:9503.name: 颂歌1
main:effect:9503.text: 随机一个友方生物获得 +1攻击力，或随机一个敌方生物失去1攻击力，持续3回合。
main:effect:9503.originalText: Either a random friendly creature gains +1 Attack or a random enemy creature loses 1 Attack for 3 turns.

main:effect:9504.name: 颂歌2
main:effect:9504.text: 随机一个友方生物获得 +2攻击力，或随机一个敌方生物失去2攻击力，持续3回合。
main:effect:9504.originalText: Either a random friendly creature gains +2 Attack or a random enemy creature loses 2 Attack for 3 turns.

main:effect:16201.name: 人道 2
main:effect:16201.text: 友方人类生物不少于2个时，所有其他友方人类生物生命值+1。
main:effect:16201.originalText: When no. of friendly human creatures is 2 or more, all other friendly human creatures gain +1 HP.

main:effect:16202.name: 人道 3
main:effect:16202.text: 友方人类生物不少于3个时，所有其他友方人类生物获得魔抗3。
main:effect:16202.originalText: When no. of friendly human creatures is 3 or more, all other friendly human creatures gain ability Resistance 3.

main:effect:16203.name: 人道 4
main:effect:16203.text: 友方人类生物不少于4个时，所有其他友方人类生物获得英勇1。
main:effect:16203.originalText: When no. of friendly human creatures is 4 or more, all other friendly human creatures gain ability Heroic 1.

main:effect:99.name: 寸拳
main:effect:99.text: 射程-1。首次攻击时，攻击力变为三倍。
main:effect:99.source: config_row:4619b21cfb1a9ae7cfbb; TypeID=15 tail index>=800; direct EffectDes translation candidate
main:effect:99.originalText: -1 Range. When attacking for the first time, Attack is tripled.

main:effect:5302.name: 先攻
main:effect:5302.text: 被射程内任意生物攻击时，会抢先攻击。
main:effect:5302.originalText: Will strike first if attacked by any creature in range.

main:effect:3997.name: 后卫
main:effect:3997.text: 所有相邻生物获得警戒：可以攻击相邻敌人，并优先攻击身后的敌人。
main:effect:3997.originalText: All adjacent creatures gain status: Vigilance (Can attack adjacent enemies, attacking backwards in preference).

main:effect:188.name: 颂歌1
main:effect:188.text: 周围格内的友方单位攻击力+1，周围格内的敌方单位攻击力-1。
main:effect:188.source: config_row:e37fc4a374edf51866dc; TypeID=15; Sol manual translation; Sol-reviewed against complete EffectDes
main:effect:188.originalText: Increase ATK of friendly units in surrounding tiles by 1, decrease ATK of enemy units in surrounding tiles by 1.

main:effect:189.name: 战歌 2
main:effect:189.text: 周围格内的友方单位攻击力+2，敌方单位攻击力-2。
main:effect:189.source: config_row:331fa7fc15fc753e1e6c; TypeID=15 tail index>=800; direct EffectDes translation candidate
main:effect:189.originalText: Increase ATK of friendly units in surrounding tiles by 2, decrease ATK of enemy units in surrounding tiles by 2.

main:effect:14111.name: 史诗传奇
main:effect:14111.text: 本单位的英雄召唤的所有单位恢复至基础生命值上限，持续5回合。
main:effect:14111.originalText: All units summoned by unit's Hero are healed to full base health. Lasts 5 rounds.

main:effect:3703.name: 击退 3
main:effect:3703.originalText: Damaged creatures will be knocked back 3 squares.

main:effect:12111.name: 狂热 1
main:effect:12111.text: 召唤者生命值不高于一半时，获得+1点攻击力。
main:effect:12111.originalText: When the summoner's HP is half or less, it gains +1 Attack.

main:effect:12112.name: 狂热 2
main:effect:12112.text: 召唤者生命值不高于一半时，获得+2点攻击力。
main:effect:12112.originalText: When the summoner's HP is half or less, it gains +2 Attack.

main:effect:5049.name: 准备
main:effect:5049.text: 此生物首回合无法行动。
main:effect:5049.originalText: This creature cannot act on it's first turn.

main:effect:3604.name: 觉醒1
main:effect:3604.text: 每回合有50%概率使召唤者手中一张倒计时最高的牌倒计时减少1。
main:effect:3604.originalText: Has a 50% chance each turn to reduce one of the cards with the highest countdown in the summoner's hand by one.

main:effect:213.name: 安然无恙
main:effect:213.text: 受到的魔法伤害降为 3 点。受到的物理伤害减少 1 点。
main:effect:213.source: config_row:70384a49b56f03fca363; TypeID=15; local-model-assisted draft; Sol-reviewed and corrected against complete EffectDes
main:effect:213.originalText: Reduces Magic damage taken to 3.Reduces Physical damage taken by 1.

main:effect:3605.name: 勤勉 1
main:effect:3605.text: 每回合有75%概率使召唤者手中倒计时最高的牌倒计时减少1，另有25%概率将其倒计时设为0。
main:effect:3605.originalText: Each turn there is a 75% chance to reduce the CD of the card with the highest CD in its summoner's hand by -1. There is a 25% chance to reduce the CD of the card with the highest CD in its summoner's hand to 0.

main:effect:3606.name: 勤勉 2
main:effect:3606.text: 每回合有75%概率使召唤者手中倒计时最高的牌倒计时减少2，另有25%概率将其倒计时设为0。
main:effect:3606.originalText: Each turn:75% chance to reduce highest CD card in its summoner's hand by -2, 25% chance to set it to 0.

main:effect:215.name: 制造麻烦
main:effect:215.text: 本生物第一回合时，将 1 个恶作剧蛋（1/0/1）放入召唤者的牌库，并将 3 个恶作剧蛋（1/0/1）放入对手牌库。
main:effect:215.source: config_row:667592cb88c775eb70b8; TypeID=15; local-model-assisted draft; Sol-reviewed and corrected against complete EffectDes
main:effect:215.originalText: On this creature's first turn, put 1 The Prankster Egg (1/0/1) in the summoner's deck and 3 The Prankster Egg (1/0/1) in your opponent's deck.

main:effect:6701.name: 灵巧
main:effect:6701.text: 无法成为单体技能的目标。
main:effect:6701.originalText: Cannot be targeted by single-target skills.

main:effect:3203.name: 幸存
main:effect:3203.text: 此生物死亡时，无论是否受到神圣攻击，均有50%概率在当前格复活。仅可触发一次。
main:effect:3203.originalText: When this creature dies regardless of holy attack, it has a 50% chance to resurrect in its current square. Can activate only once.

main:effect:234.name: 法力涌动 1
main:effect:234.text: 使召唤者手中准备值最高的一张牌准备值-1。
main:effect:234.source: config_row:6742fd505261cc1d208e; TypeID=15 tail index>=800; direct EffectDes translation candidate
main:effect:234.originalText: Reduces the Countdown of a card with the highest Countdown in its summoner's hand by 1.

main:effect:1212.name: 魔抗 2
main:effect:1212.text: 受到的法术伤害减少2点。

main:effect:235.name: 法力涌动 2
main:effect:235.text: 使召唤者手中准备值最高的两张牌准备值-1。
main:effect:235.source: config_row:7ff648fbba89f5a1b477; TypeID=15 tail index>=800; direct EffectDes translation candidate
main:effect:235.originalText: Reduces the Countdown of two card with the highest Countdown in its summoner's hand by 1.

main:effect:1213.name: 魔抗 3
main:effect:1213.text: 受到的法术伤害减少3点。

main:effect:6303.name: 法术护盾
main:effect:6303.originalText: Cannot be affected by negative effects.

main:effect:239.name: 狙击步枪 1
main:effect:239.text: 射程+3。攻击目标生物及其身后的敌方生物或英雄。造成的伤害无法被减免，且被消灭的生物无法触发还魂、魂缚或骷髅。
main:effect:239.source: config_row:039181b83e8587da5a1e; TypeID=15; local-model-assisted draft; Sol-reviewed and corrected against complete EffectDes
main:effect:239.originalText: +3 Range. Attacks target creature, as well as the enemy creature or hero behind. Damage dealt cannot be reduced, and creatures killed cannot activate ability Reanimate, Soulbound, or Skeleton.

main:effect:240.name: 狙击步枪 2
main:effect:240.text: 射程+4。攻击目标生物及其后方的敌方生物或英雄。造成的伤害无法被减免，被击杀的生物无法触发还魂、魂缚或骸骨化。
main:effect:240.source: config_row:3f55cca770442660daaa; TypeID=15 tail index>=800; direct EffectDes translation candidate
main:effect:240.originalText: +4 Range. Attacks target creature, as well as the enemy creature or hero behind. Damage dealt cannot be reduced, and creatures killed cannot activate ability Reanimate, Soulbound, or Skeleton.

main:effect:15713.name: 瞄准 1
main:effect:15713.text: 攻击敌方召唤者时，额外造成1点远程伤害。
main:effect:15713.originalText: When attacks enemy summoner, deals 1 extra ranged damage.

main:effect:15714.name: 瞄准 2
main:effect:15714.text: 攻击敌方召唤者时，额外造成2点远程伤害。
main:effect:15714.originalText: When attacks enemy summoner, deals 2 extra ranged damage.

main:effect:7901.name: 撤退
main:effect:7901.text: 受到敌方攻击时，按自身移动距离后退以躲避伤害；若仍在敌方攻击范围内，则依然受到伤害。
main:effect:7901.originalText: Creature will retreat by movement range to avoid damage from enemy attack, will still take damage if within enemy attack range.

main:effect:5062.name: 屠龙1
main:effect:5062.text: 进场后的首回合，对所有敌方士兵造成2点近战伤害。
main:effect:5062.originalText: Deals 2 points of melee damage to all enemy soldiers on the first turn after entering the field.

main:effect:243.name: 剑术1
main:effect:243.text: 对准备值不低于5的生物造成双倍伤害。伤害无法被减免。屠龙者每消灭一个敌方单位，获得+1攻击力。
main:effect:243.source: config_row:cf4ed74e7904554a4b89; TypeID=15; Sol manual translation; Sol-reviewed against complete EffectDes
main:effect:243.originalText: Deals double damage to creatures with a countdown of 5CD or more. Damage cannot be reduced. Whenever DragonSlayer kills an enemy unit, it gains +1 ATK.

main:effect:5063.name: 屠龙2
main:effect:5063.text: 进场后的首回合，对所有敌方士兵造成3点近战伤害。

main:effect:28451.source: config_row:5dbc69d1f5c852d8be39; TypeID=15; local-model-assisted draft; Sol-reviewed and corrected against complete EffectDes
main:effect:28451.originalText: Upon death, deal 5 Shadow damage to all enemy creatures. 25% chance to return to the summoner's hand on death.

main:effect:28461.name: 机械共鸣
main:effect:28461.text: 射程+1。攻击1×3范围内的所有敌方生物和英雄。对骑兵、飞行、弓手、护甲和城墙生物造成双倍伤害。每回合恢复5点生命值。
main:effect:28461.source: config_row:293cda00f9d241ae7154; TypeID=15; local-model-assisted draft; Sol-reviewed and corrected against complete EffectDes
main:effect:28461.originalText: Range +1. Attacks all enemy creatures and heroes in a 1x3 area. Deals double damage to Cavalry, Flying, Archer, Armour, and Wall creatures.Restores 5 HP each turn.

main:effect:28462.name: 精准逻辑
main:effect:28462.text: 先攻。召唤时，获得圣域：反射受到的所有伤害，持续3回合。
main:effect:28462.source: config_row:edfea560a21b6a6c00f3; TypeID=15; local-model-assisted draft; Sol-reviewed and corrected against complete EffectDes
main:effect:28462.originalText: First Strike. When summoned, gain status: Sanctuary-reflects all damage taken for 3 turns.

main:effect:28463.name: 钢铁先锋
main:effect:28463.text: 法术护盾。死亡时，对击杀它的生物造成N点神圣伤害，N等于攻击者的攻击力。己方新召唤的生物获得钢铁先锋：射程+1、攻击力+2、反击，持续3回合。
main:effect:28463.source: config_row:390a30d5eff8afa4e545; TypeID=15 tail index>=800; direct EffectDes translation candidate
main:effect:28463.originalText: Shield Ward. Upon death, deal N Holy damage to the creature that killed it, where N equals the attacker's ATK. Own newly summoned creatures gain:Steel Vanguard-Range +1, +2 ATK, Counterattack for 3 turns.

main:effect:28464.name: 超速驱动
main:effect:28464.text: 击杀敌方生物时，攻击力+3、生命值+3。首回合从牌库抽1张牌加入手牌；也有50%概率改为抽2张牌。
main:effect:28464.source: config_row:650dc22472c642a0d523; TypeID=15 tail index>=800; direct EffectDes translation candidate
main:effect:28464.originalText: When killing an enemy creature, gain +3 ATK, +3 HP. On first turn, either draw 1 card from your deck into Hand, or have a 50% chance to draw 2 cards there instead.

main:effect:206002.name: 烈焰领域 1
main:effect:206002.text: 行动时，对相邻格内的敌方生物造成1点火焰伤害。
main:effect:206002.originalText: When acting, deals 1 Fire damage to enemy creatures in adjacent squares.

main:effect:206003.name: 烈焰领域 2
main:effect:206003.text: 行动时，对相邻格内的敌方生物造成2点火焰伤害。
main:effect:206003.originalText: When acting, deals 2 Fire damage to enemy creatures in adjacent squares.

main:effect:56179.name: 活体炸弹
main:effect:56179.text: 每回合随机使1个敌方生物获得活体炸弹，持续1回合：行动时对相邻格内所有友方生物造成5点火焰伤害，并使其眩晕1回合。
main:effect:56179.originalText: Each turn, randomly grants 1 enemy creature Living Bomb for 1 turn. (Living Bomb: When acting, deals 5 Fire damage and Stuns all friendly creatures in adjacent squares for 1 turn.)

main:effect:206004.name: 烈焰领域 3
main:effect:206004.text: 行动时，对相邻格内的敌方生物造成3点火焰伤害。
main:effect:206004.originalText: When acting, deals 3 Fire damage to enemy creatures in adjacent squares.

main:effect:28475.name: 热能屏障
main:effect:28475.text: 受到火焰伤害时，将伤害降至0；受到非火焰伤害时，伤害减半。受到物理伤害时，使攻击者攻击力-5，持续3回合。免疫移动限制效果。
main:effect:28475.source: config_row:8ef002b5a8cf9d7fe263; TypeID=15 tail index>=800; direct EffectDes translation candidate
main:effect:28475.originalText: When taking Fire damage, reduce the damage to 0. When taking non-Fire damage, reduce the damage by half. When taking Physical damage, reduce the attacker's ATK by 5 for 3 turns. Immune to movement restriction effects.

main:effect:28508.name: 吞噬爆炸 I
main:effect:28508.text: 射程-1。召唤时获得法术护盾，持续1回合。吞噬周围1格内攻击力最高的敌方生物。吞噬后触发爆炸，对周围1格内的所有敌方生物造成N点无法减免的伤害（N等于被吞噬生物的攻击力与此生物攻击力之和）。
main:effect:28508.source: config_row:a5646ec7e06873daa6fa; TypeID=15; local-model-assisted draft; Sol-reviewed and corrected against complete EffectDes
main:effect:28508.originalText: Range -1. When summoned, gain Shield Ward for 1 turn. Devour the enemy creature with the highest ATK within 1 square. After Devour, trigger Explosive, dealing N unreduceable damage to all enemy creatures within 1 square. (N equals the ATK of the Devoured creature plus this creature's ATK.)

main:effect:7706.name: 共同湮灭
main:effect:7706.text: 爆裂后，将此生物和被吞噬的敌方生物从战场移除。
main:effect:7706.originalText: After Explosive, remove this creature and the Devoured enemy creature from the battlefield.

main:effect:28509.name: 吞噬爆击 2
main:effect:28509.text: 射程-1。召唤时获得法术护盾，持续1回合。吞噬周围1格内攻击力最高的敌方生物。吞噬后触发爆炸，对周围2格内的所有敌方生物造成N点无法减免的伤害（N等于被吞噬生物的攻击力与此生物攻击力之和）。
main:effect:28509.source: config_row:b7c048394b7c830f45e0; TypeID=15; local-model-assisted draft; Sol-reviewed and corrected against complete EffectDes
main:effect:28509.originalText: Range -1. When summoned, gain Shield Ward for 1 turn. Devour the enemy creature with the highest ATK within 1 square. After Devour, trigger Explosive, dealing N unreduceable damage to all enemy creatures within 2 squares. (N equals the ATK of the Devoured creature plus this creature's ATK.)

main:effect:28511.name: 腐毒 I

main:effect:28510.source: config_row:6192dc3098021ad51d55; TypeID=15; local-model-assisted draft; Sol-reviewed and corrected against complete EffectDes

main:effect:28512.name: 腐化毒液 2
main:effect:28512.text: 使受伤生物每回合受到5点暗影伤害，持续3回合。受伤生物在5回合内无法被治疗或获得属性增益。

main:effect:28517.source: config_row:6d7d1802dc87900f4cf3; TypeID=15 tail index>=800; direct EffectDes translation candidate

main:effect:56183.name: 疯狂茶会派对
main:effect:56183.text: 每回合使一个随机敌方生物在1回合内无法行动。
main:effect:56183.originalText: Each turn, one random enemy creature cannot act for 1 turn.

main:effect:220001.name: 扭转回溯时光
main:effect:220001.text: 此生物受到致命伤害时，有33%概率存活，并将生命值恢复至上回合结束时的数值。
main:effect:220001.originalText: If this creature takes lethal damage, it has a 33% chance to survive and return to the HP it had at the end of its previous turn.

main:effect:28570.name: 连击压制
main:effect:28570.text: 移动力+1。一次攻击中攻击2次。压制攻击：攻击时，目标不会触发预阻、先攻或反击。对拥有预阻、反击或先攻的敌方生物造成双倍伤害。
main:effect:28570.source: config_row:b79ed0a1453fd0becab6; TypeID=15 tail index>=800; direct EffectDes translation candidate
main:effect:28570.originalText: Movement +1. Attack 2 times in a single strike. Suppressive Attack-When attacking, the target does not trigger Forestall, First Strike, or Counterattack. Deals double damage to enemy creatures with Forestall, Counterattack, or First Strike.

main:effect:28571.name: 护甲之刃
main:effect:28571.text: 造成的伤害无法被减免。受伤生物获得特殊状态“护甲”：受到的物理伤害增加4点，且受到的物理伤害无法被减免，持续5回合。
main:effect:28571.source: config_row:af2ed6247b3172566b8d; TypeID=15; Sol manual translation; Sol-reviewed against complete EffectDes
main:effect:28571.originalText: Damage dealt cannot be reduced. Damaged creatures gain the special status – Armor: Physical damage taken +4, Physical damage taken cannot be reduced, for 5 turns.

main:effect:28572.name: 迅捷神经

main:effect:28572.originalText: When taking Combo damage, only takes damage from the first hit. When taking damage, ATK +2, HP +3.

main:effect:28573.name: 王者权威
main:effect:28573.text: 免疫魅惑和惊吓。打出时，使所有敌方生物的攻击力降低50%。敌方生物的光环效果失效。
main:effect:28573.source: config_row:f28cf2da71cbec80316a; TypeID=15 tail index>=800; direct EffectDes translation candidate
main:effect:28573.originalText: Immune to Charm and Scary. When played, all enemy creatures’ ATK is reduced by 50%. Enemy creatures’ Aura effects are disabled.

main:effect:28634.name: 狂暴
main:effect:28634.text: 移动力提升至最大值。可以越过非城墙生物。攻击后向后移动。移动时，对沿途越过的敌方生物造成等同于自身攻击力的伤害。

main:effect:28634.originalText: Movement is increased to the maximum. Can pass over non-Wall creatures. Moves backward after attacking. Deals damage equal to its ATK to enemy creatures it passes through while moving.

main:effect:28635.name: 重甲
main:effect:28635.text: 受到的物理伤害减少4点。护甲。受到的法术伤害减少4点。魔抗。极寒屏障。
main:effect:28635.source: config_row:b117a87eb8926398e3bc; TypeID=15 tail index>=800; direct EffectDes translation candidate

main:effect:17176.originalText: On death, deals 5 Fire damage to all adjacent enemy creatures.

main:effect:28641.name: 时间锁

main:effect:28641.source: config_row:5915ec1d970478b4b0c1; TypeID=15; Sol manual translation; Sol-reviewed against complete EffectDes
main:effect:28641.originalText: Range +2. Damaged creatures gain Time Lock: Cannot act and ATK -2, HP -3 each turn for 1 turn.

main:effect:18154.name: 时光秩序

main:effect:18154.originalText: While on the battlefield, Inspiration and Distraction effects on all friendly and enemy creatures are disabled.

main:effect:28643.name: 时间回溯

main:effect:28643.source: config_row:36121270e1c09dd7738c; TypeID=15 tail index>=800; direct EffectDes translation candidate
main:effect:28643.originalText: When taking lethal damage, 75% chance to survive and reset HP to its previous value. While on the battlefield, all other friendly creatures have a 25% chance to survive lethal damage and reset HP to its previous value.

main:effect:28644.name: 时间共鸣
main:effect:28644.text: 法术护盾。准备值能力：墓地中每有2张生物牌，每回合开始时此牌的准备值-1。进入战场后的首回合，将召唤者墓地中的3张牌放回牌库。
main:effect:28644.source: config_row:973c8a9d1469437bfe5b; TypeID=15 tail index>=800; direct EffectDes translation candidate
main:effect:28644.originalText: Shield Ward. Countdown ability. For every 2 creature cards in the Graveyard, this card's Countdown is reduced by 1 at the start of each turn. On its first turn after entering the battlefield, put 3 cards from the Summoner's Graveyard into the Deck.

main:effect:28646.source: config_row:76e758f0ceedf2105a8c; TypeID=15; local-model-assisted draft; Sol-reviewed and corrected against complete EffectDes
main:effect:28646.originalText: Range +1. When creature takes damage, Attack will increase by the amount lost; if creature is healed, Attack will decrease by amount of HP gained. If this creature takes lethal damage, it will finish its own turn before dying.
